links.outcome: Ambient scribe support for non-English speaking patients, per physician interviews
links.effect: Barriers to adoption included limited functionality with non-English speaking patients and lack of access for physicians without a specific device.
links.quote: Barriers to adoption included limited functionality with non-English speaking patients and lack of access for physicians without a specific device.

links.outcome: Physician perceptions of scribe accuracy, style, workload, and time
links.effect: Positive on cognitive demand (16 of 16 comments, 100%), temporal demand (62%), overall workload (89%); accuracy and style largely negative, particularly note length and editing requirements.
links.quote: Physician perspectives on accuracy and style were largely negative, particularly regarding note length and editing requirements.

screen.reason: This is a qualitative empirical study evaluating clinician experiences and perspectives following a real-world pilot deployment of an ambient AI scribe tool.
